en.topic_title: Court of Appeal upholds ruling against gov’t over Fanling golf course housing plan
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s appeals court has ruled against the government in a legal challenge connected with plans to build public housing on a golf course in Fanling.



Fanling golf course. Photo: Wikicommons.



The Court of Appeal handed down the verdict on Monday, upholding a lower court’s earlier judgement.
